title: Sorting press: Threshold file
topics: Recursion, sorting, binary search and bits
summary: Produce readings sorted numerically ascending using a merge-based divide-and-conquer approach. Keep duplicate readings. Return how many values in the derived sequence are at least k.
descriptionMd:
Two small sorted proof trays are repeatedly joined by the office's divide-and-merge press. Tomas marks a threshold on the filing cabinet's inspection card. Only qualifying readings count toward today's clearance stamp.

Produce readings sorted numerically ascending using a merge-based divide-and-conquer approach. Keep duplicate readings.

Return how many values in the derived sequence are at least k.

Implement sortingPressThresholdFile(readings, k). Use k exactly where specified above.
unitIntro: Merge sort. Produce readings sorted numerically ascending using a merge-based divide-and-conquer approach. Keep duplicate readings. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.

Target time O(n log n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with merge sort. What state describes the portion you have already processed?

Produce readings sorted numerically ascending using a merge-based divide-and-conquer approach. Keep duplicate readings. Derive each required reading once; do not restart the whole procedure for every output position.
Return how many values in the derived sequence are at least k. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.
